meta.title: VNT — Web design & development
meta.description: A design and development studio. We design and build websites and digital products end to end.

hero.title: A website for your business, built to grow.
hero.subtitle: There are two of us: a designer and a developer. You work directly with the people doing the work, with nobody in between.

services.title: The whole path, one team
services.intro: A small team that takes you from the idea to a site that is live and working. Design, development and launch, with no hand-offs between vendors.

items.title: Product & brand design
items.description: Visual identity, design system and interface. Prototypes you can click through before a single line of code.

items.title: Web development
items.description: Fast, accessible sites and apps that are easy to maintain. Clean code we own, without odd dependencies.

items.title: Launch
items.description: Domain, hosting, analytics and technical SEO. We hand over a running, documented site.

items.title: Maintenance & growth
items.description: We stay close: new sections, performance work and support whenever you need it.

steps.title: We talk
steps.description: We learn about your business, who it speaks to and what the site has to achieve. No endless forms.

steps.title: A clear proposal
steps.description: Scope, timeline and price in writing. No surprises halfway through.

steps.title: Design & build
steps.description: We work in parallel, with deliverables you can see and comment on every week.

steps.title: Launch
steps.description: We ship, measure and adjust. And we show you how to handle whatever you want to touch.

work.title: Work
work.empty: We're putting these case studies together. In the meantime, get in touch and we'll walk you through the work.

studio.title: The studio
studio.intro: Two people and a simple method: few things at a time, done well.

contact.title: Let's work together
contact.intro: Tell us what you need and we'll get back to you within 48 business hours.

signature.title: Signature
signature.intro: The block we leave at the footer of the projects we build. Copy the relevant snippet and replace the client name in the ref parameter.
signature.note: The ref parameter tracks which project drives visits. Use the client slug, lowercase and without spaces.
